description: This file defines a class 'Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Proxy' that extends the socket-based HTTP client adapter to add support for proxy connections, including handling of HTTPS tunneling via CONNECT method. It manages proxy configuration, connection establishment, request writing, and HTTPS handshake with the proxy.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Proxy
classes.description: A proxy-enabled HTTP client adapter extending socket-based communication, capable of handling proxy connection setup, including SSL and HTTPS tunneling via CONNECT.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the proxy server or directly to the target server if no proxy is set.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request through the proxy, preparing headers and handling HTTPS CONNECT handshake if needed.

methods.name: connectHandshake
methods.description: Performs the CONNECT method handshake to establish a tunnel for HTTPS proxying.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection and resets the negotiated state.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor to ensure socket is closed upon object destruction.
